Hi Olivia & Daniel,

Thanks again for your time today — really appreciated the thoughtful questions from the buying committee. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of demo highlights
- Live inference latency at 99th percentile: ~120ms on your target sequence length (we demoed the r-model-3-small profile).
- Cost/opportunities: intelligent batching + prefix caching expected to reduce token costs by ~25% for your chat-heavy workload.
- Security: Private deployment option with VPC + KMS key support addresses your data residency ask.

Stakeholder mapping we captured during the call
- Economic buyer: Olivia Barnes (Head of Platform) — owns budget approval.
- Technical champion: Daniel Lee (Sr. Eng) — owns integration and performance validation.
- Security/compliance: Procurement + Legal (we heard procurement@fintechco.com will lead the SOC 2 evidence review).
- Operators/Prod Owners: Data Platform team (TBD names) — will validate runbooks and SLOs.

Requested next steps (recommended timeline)
1) We’ll share the written recap + artifacts: post-demo PDF (attached) and a short SOC2 summary (attached). — Today (done).
2) Procurement asks: Olivia/Daniel to introduce us to the procurement contact and legal owner so we can send standard security docs and answer any questionnaire items. — Target: by Fri 24 Jul.
3) Technical POC scope: Redwood proposes a 2-week POC (dedicated capacity trial) focused on two core flows: customer support chat and billing NLU. We’ll provide an ops runbook and performance baseline. — Decision point: sign POC SOW.
4) Pricing/commit: We can model Dedicated pricing vs Hosted usage and show estimated monthly spend for target QPS.

Action items for today
- @Olivia: confirm procurement & legal contact (email reply OK).
- @Daniel: confirm whether the Data Platform team is required in the POC and share any perf/sequence-length samples we should test.
- @Team (cc): Nikhil & Lauren will draft the POC SOW and a short security evidence packet by Thursday.

Attachments: Redwood-post-demo-recap.pdf (PDF), SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick follow-up if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
